::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 11th 1895  
**From:** Elderfield  Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Hampshire Record Office 67M92W/82/24
:::

Dear [Mr Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)

[Mrs Yonge](people/person_1604.qmd) comes to Otterbourne Vicarage this afternoon, and will be in the village till some day next week.  I think you had better send the papers to me, as I am not certain whether she will be at the Vicarage or the Grange, and I will get her signature[^1]

Please pay the 4/ and add to your account

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The Vicarage was the home of Frances Yonge's daughter Alethea Bowles, and the Grange of their friend [Mrs Jones Bateman](people/person_784.qmd).
